Cookie Policy

Last updated: August 2026

What Are Cookies?

Cookies are small text files stored on your device that help websites function correctly and improve the user experience.

How We Use Cookies

DailyScope uses cookies to remember preferences, analyse website traffic and improve performance.

Third-Party Cookies

Third-party services such as Google Analytics and Google AdSense may place cookies on your device according to their own privacy policies.

Managing Cookies

You can control or delete cookies through your browser settings. Disabling cookies may affect certain website features.

DailyScope

DailyScope is an independent digital news platform that aggregates breaking news from trusted media across the United States. Our mission is to provide a clean, fast and reliable reading experience.
